ticket.title: rabbet-core also referenced the dado language_serde module deleted under GB-143
ticket.description: FIXED in rabbet main ebe12ca. The fourth and last dependent missed by dado c88b13c, which deleted language_serde under the GB-143 repoint: rabbet-core still had two #[serde(with = "dado_core::language_serde")] attributes plus an option_language_serde wrapper delegating to the deleted module, and no gaugeblock-contracts dependency. Found by the first suite-wide outfeed gate sweep - rabbet had not been gated in some time. Fixed by adding the contracts dependency, typing Language as the wire enum across src and tests (db/queries, miner/cold_miner, miner/pattern_miner and four test files), dropping both attributes and rewriting the option wrapper over the wire type. Verified clean with cargo check -p rabbet-core --all-targets. Sweep of dependents now complete: dado, batten, joiner and rabbet all build.

verification_receipt.summary: Verified retroactively: the fix shipped in rabbet main ebe12ca but the ticket was filed with a FIXED note instead of a receipt. rabbet-core carried two #[serde(with = "dado_core::language_serde")] attributes plus an option_language_serde wrapper delegating to the module dado deleted on purpose in c88b13c, and it had no gaugeblock-contracts dependency. Fixed by adding the dependency, typing Language as the wire enum across src and tests, dropping both attributes and rewriting the option wrapper over the wire type. Confirmed clean with cargo check -p rabbet-core --all-targets and by the suite sweep, where rabbet reports 4 passed, 0 failed.
